pearl-bed-a#0.notes: Pearl Bed: low wide rock cluster, three pink clams with violet (essence) pearls, clear foam band at the waterline; reads at 1x on deep and shallow water

pearl-bed-a#1.notes: tall stacked pile, the top clam pokes up like a spire; less calm than #0

pearl-bed-a#2.notes: good, but the rock arch reads as a cave, too close to the grottos; #0 is clearer

pearl-bed-a#3.notes: busy heap of five clams, no foam band; noisier than #0

tiny-a#0.notes: Buoy: fat red-white striped buoy, bell in an iron cage, foam band; the simplest read of the four buoys

tiny-a#1.notes: buoy squashed wide, candy-stripe body with barnacle clutter at the foot

tiny-a#2.notes: buoy with a brown wooden cage and a dirty flag; muddier than #0

tiny-a#3.notes: buoy with a side lantern; near duplicate of #0 with extra clutter

tiny-a#4.notes: Mermaid Rock: a golden scallop full of coins on a round sea rock, foam band; the luck site reads as shell and treasure at 1x

tiny-a#5.notes: closed shell between two boulders, no coins, no foam: reads as a plain rock

tiny-a#6.notes: good but starfish clutter and a fainter foam band; #4 is cleaner

tiny-a#7.notes: dark mossy rock under a towering shell, heavy and murky at 1x

tiny-a#8.notes: the shrine reads as a stone igloo or cave, no columns

tiny-a#9.notes: pale shrine on a foam disc; the emblem is tiny and the body washes out on shallow water

tiny-a#10.notes: Shrine of the Tides: shell-domed shrine with a big glowing blue spiral in its doorway and starfish; the strongest read of the shrines (its foot is stone, the foam band faint)

tiny-a#11.notes: dark seaweed-hung shrine whose emblem is a small diamond; murkier than #10

tiny-a#12.notes: whirlpool as a bright white disc in a rock ring: reads as a hole or a pond, not a spin

tiny-a#13.notes: one open spiral arm and no rim; ragged, reads as smoke

tiny-a#14.notes: dark see-through swirl with planks: noisy at 1x

tiny-a#15.notes: Whirlpool: a ring of dark wet rocks round a white foam spiral; reads as a whirlpool at 1x on both waters (the spiral is baked, code may add the spin over it)

siren-grotto-a#0.notes: Siren Grotto: a round teal sea cave, its arch framed in pink shells, a pink conch on top, seaweed and a golden harp; reads as the sirens' home at 1x (no foam band: the rock meets the water directly)

siren-grotto-a#1.notes: stepped cone with a small mouth; harp and conch read smaller, less inviting than #0

siren-grotto-a#2.notes: near duplicate of #0 with a heavier seaweed curtain

siren-grotto-a#3.notes: spiky crag with shell garlands: busy, and the jagged top fights the chunky style

sirens-rock-a#0.notes: Sirens' Rock: a tall dark crag with a big golden lyre on its seat, mirror and comb on the ledges, bones, an oar, pink coral and a foam band; the clearest lyre of the four

sirens-rock-a#1.notes: near duplicate of #0 with carved steps; the lyre sits lower and reads smaller

sirens-rock-a#2.notes: near duplicate of #0, the crag a lumpier pile

sirens-rock-a#3.notes: stair-cut crag reads as a ruined tower, busier than #0

shipwreck-a#0.notes: Shipwreck small: a low broken hull, one snapped mast with a torn grey-green sail, a chest on deck; modest, as a small bank should be

shipwreck-a#1.notes: Shipwreck medium: a tilted broken hull, two snapped masts and torn sails, gold on deck; a clear step up from #0

shipwreck-a#2.notes: Shipwreck large: a big three-masted wreck in torn sails, gold in its open hold; the grandest and still readable at 1x

shipwreck-a#3.notes: large: darker, mossier and split in two; at 1x the dark planks and moss turn to mush beside #2

coral-grotto-a#0.notes: Coral Grotto small: a low grey rock dome with a small cave mouth, a few coral sprigs and violet pearls, a foam band; modest

coral-grotto-a#1.notes: Coral Grotto medium: a wider rock mound, a bigger cave mouth, more pink, orange and violet coral and ore chunks at the mouth; a clear step up

coral-grotto-a#2.notes: large: a tall grey cave with the coral only at its edges; reads as a plain cave beside #3

coral-grotto-a#3.notes: Coral Grotto large: a grand rock arch under a crown of big pink, orange and violet corals, pearls and dark ore at the mouth; the richest look of the three

krakens-deep-a#0.notes: Kraken's Deep: a wide ring of black rocks round a dark navy pool, three curling purple tentacles rising from it, a sunken mast and a gold chest; reads as the one great sea bank at 1x (the only candidate of a 200 x 144 call)

lighthouse-a#0.notes: Lighthouse: a fat red-and-white striped tower with a warm lit lantern and a red cap on a round grey rock islet with steps; the chunkiest, clearest of the nine (no foam band: the islet meets the water)

lighthouse-a#1.notes: squat tower with a shed tacked on its side; the shed reads as a second building

lighthouse-a#2.notes: spiral-striped tower on a stepped islet: candy-cane stripes, too close to the Candy Kingdom's look

lighthouse-a#3.notes: slim tower with a gallery and a ladder; thinner and busier than #0

lighthouse-a#4.notes: jagged spiky rocks and a weathervane; the spikes fight the chunky style

lighthouse-a#5.notes: a little jetty juts from the islet: reads as a second object

lighthouse-a#6.notes: small leaning tower with a pipe on a mossy rock: weak at 1x

lighthouse-a#7.notes: stone-walled base and a crane: a pier, not an islet

lighthouse-a#8.notes: crates and barrels clutter the islet; near duplicate of #0 otherwise

fishing-village-a#0.notes: Fishing Village: two plump whitewashed cottages under blue slate roofs, a fish-drying rack at the front left, net, barrels and a blue rowboat at the right; reads as a shore village beside the inn

fishing-village-a#1.notes: near duplicate of #0 with the rack half hidden behind the net

fishing-village-a#2.notes: three gables and two tall chimneys: busier, the cottages merge at 1x

fishing-village-a#3.notes: one cottage with dormers: reads as a single house, not a village

pirate-cove-a#0.notes: good, but the shack hides the rock; reads as a plain hut with a flag beside #3

pirate-cove-a#1.notes: stair-roofed shack in a pale rock: the roof tiles turn to noise at 1x

pirate-cove-a#2.notes: tall barn shape; the rock is a thin backdrop

pirate-cove-a#3.notes: Pirate Cove: a patched plank shack built into a big round sandy rock, a skull flag on top, a cannon, barrels and a small chest at the front; the most cove-like of the four

shipwright-a#0.notes: Shipwright: a big plank boat shed under a red-brown roof, an unfinished round hull on its cradle inside, a timber crane at the right and planks and tools at the front left; reads as the place to buy ships (the only candidate of a 200 x 144 call)

ferry-landing-a#0.notes: good, but the bell is small; #9 carries the bell better

ferry-landing-a#1.notes: gallows-like post over the jetty: reads grim

ferry-landing-a#2.notes: jetty fills the cell and the boat is cut short at the right

ferry-landing-a#3.notes: grey weathered planks: dull and reads as a ruin

ferry-landing-a#4.notes: near duplicate of #9 with a lower post

ferry-landing-a#5.notes: railings and a rope tangle: busy at 1x

ferry-landing-a#7.notes: the boat merges into the jetty and a stray light pixel floats at the right

ferry-landing-a#8.notes: a little roofed shed on the jetty: a second building

ferry-landing-a#9.notes: Ferry Landing: a stubby plank jetty on round posts, a tall post at its front left with a big brass bell and a lantern, a coiled rope and a blue rowboat tied alongside; the bell is the clearest of the sixteen

ferry-landing-a#10.notes: forest of posts and no visible bell: noise at 1x

ferry-landing-a#11.notes: small bell, the jetty a bare frame

ferry-landing-a#12.notes: an extra flag post; bell smaller than #9

ferry-landing-a#13.notes: the jetty points away and the boat sits behind it: weak silhouette

ferry-landing-a#14.notes: near duplicate of #9, the bell half behind the post

ferry-landing-a#15.notes: steps at the front and the boat hidden: reads as a stage
